text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was walking with Durandal.
We spotted a single kitten in the bushes.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it was only recently born.
However, there's no sign of a mother cat nearby—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
............
Alright! This is a job for me, the knight!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Protecting the weak is also a knight's duty.
I shall splendidly serve as that cat's protector.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hold it! I didn't mean for you to stop—
I told you to wait on defense!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the cries of a kitty, I have arrived from the Academy!
I shall protect that cat!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... Step back, Right O-san!
I have resolved to protect this cat!
On my honor as a knight!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Pride—heh. You think something like that will let you
entertain these kitties better than I can?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Face reality!
Take this! The tales of how wildly popular I am with kitties!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"'Every time I say hello to a kitty I meet—
they look right back into my eyes!'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Doesn't an animal making eye contact with you
actually mean it's on guard?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Gwah!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A counterattack, huh? Not bad!
However, that isn't the only episode that demonstrates my feline aptitude!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Her ear twitches sync up with my every move!"
"She can pick up a silent meow 100% of the time!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Guh! Th-that's... impressive...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And—"I have crawled into a stray cat meeting
and been fully accepted!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gahk?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, child's play.
Now then, I shall protect the kitty.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, not yet!
—Hear this! The tale of my ultimate cat-attracting prowess!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Secret Sword Technique! "While Idly Watching
a Gathering of Cats on a Park Bench—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "A timid-looking cat that couldn't blend into the gathering hesitantly climbed onto my lap—and started purring contentedly!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah!?!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are completely battered...
At this rate, their bodies won't hold out.
I don't understand how this damage works, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, my liege... please wait a moment.
I shall certainly rescue the cat for you to—
choice_data_list: ...Don't both of you share the same ambition?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Th-That's right! Right O and I
both want to save the cat just the same!
—Though I do want to be praised a little, too...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If we fight amongst ourselves despite our high ideals—
a ruin like that of the Knights of the Round Table awaits.
That is what the "King" is telling us...!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ――Let's stop fighting, Right O-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "What we need to do right now isn't fight. We must join forces and protect the cat together!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes—the Holy Cat Order of Guardian Knights.
Let us dedicate our swords together to the vow of protecting the weak!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a knight?! What absurd nonsense!
Besides, I don't even own a personalized sword!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I shall grant you a hand-me-down.
A straight sword, embodying the very soul of a knight—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite understand,
but it seems the matter has been settled.
choice_data_list: Then let's rescue that cat right away...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! First, match your eye level
with the cat's—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No. Before that, we should meow like cats
to let them know we're friends.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Doing that recklessly
will only make it even more wary.
Besides, it's not like anyone can speak Cat—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...While we were arguing, the mother cat showed up, bringing the matter to a close.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Why, of course, that would be m—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wha-?! It should be me, right?!
I was the one who proposed it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who finished saying it first. I'm the one who knows more about kitties. Therefore, the leader of the Kitty Lovers Club is me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, a sudden name change?!
To such an arrogant crowd, the Commander—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...While we were arguing, the mother cat showed up, bringing the matter to a close.
